THE BASICS

Pick up.
Throw down.

PLAYER 01

PLAYER 02

←→ move ↑ jump / flutter ↓ crouch

K fire L grab / throw / revive O call Enter strafe

Classic PvP: start unarmed. Pick up glowing equipment and outlast everyone else. One hit eliminates you; ten round wins take the match. Empty weapon? Throw it, then grab another. Explosions can hurt you. Hold jump to flutter. Down + jump drops through a platform. Hold strafe to move without changing aim. Tide (or lava) rises after 25 seconds.

Zombie survival: 1–4 local players work together against endless waves. You start with a pistol and 100 health. Enemies drop health and ammunition; equipment respawns during waves. Hold grab near a downed teammate for two seconds to revive them before their 18-second bleed-out. Fallen teammates return after a cleared wave. Earn points for kills and wave clears; buy health, damage, or speed upgrades between waves. Teammates cannot shoot each other; your own explosions still hurt. Runners arrive at wave 3, brutes at wave 5.

Controllers: left stick / D-pad move · south button jump · west button fire · north button grab / throw / revive · east button call · left bumper strafe · Start pauses. For three/four humans, keyboard controls players 1–2 and the first one/two connected controllers control players 3–4. In one/two-human games controllers map to players 1–2. Escape pauses. Desktop keyboard or controller required; internet multiplayer and touch controls are not included.
